assessments.reasoning: Internet Archive’s 20060411044402id_ capture preserves the OSI origin http://opensource.org:80/licenses/afl-2.1.php. OSI is the publishing witness, Internet Archive provides the retrieval route, and the text credits Lawrence E. Rosen. The 17,761-byte HTML has reported SHA-256 70e1b6f72cd73f7593c6659abd072b8b28157112b15dba4d24f92c62ebbbfa43. The heading and prescribed notice identify v2.1, and §§1–3 set out copyright, patent and source-code terms. The linked plain text is a separate representation.

The Index’s SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 expressly includes historical editions. Its admission table at bytes [533,942) covers the identifiable v2.1 grant documented by OSI. The table requires member-level evidence for individual editions, which the archived v2.1 text supplies.

OSI’s license-discuss archive identifies Lawrence Rosen’s 2021-09-08 reply, message 021969, SHA-256 203753e50d9da13cd4e735867cbc305b07b25e251d62f17c4d84f7702636e245. Rosen endorsed the 3.0 forms. His earlier message quoted at bytes [5751,5874) called pre-3.0 AFL and OSL versions “no longer valid” and requested removal. Smith proposed the term “superseded.” This supports the claim’s attributed chronology. Rosen’s approval recollection and Brasseur’s report of missing definitive proof leave formal board documentation unresolved. The exchange records no SPDX or Index decision.

At License Index commit afb962e68831a16accb80c70159b1e2f1fbb4dbc, decision bytes [1432,1626) identify 8894d3ad16a241d59ffd190bee24f555, the opaque ID in subject e-8894d3ad16a241d59ffd190bee24f555. The row gives Academic Free License v2.1, afl-2-1, sha256:70e1b6f72cd73f7593c6659abd072b8b28157112b15dba4d24f92c62ebbbfa43, license and historical. The adjacent v3.0 row has a different entity, revision and lifecycle.

challenge.method: Compared the archived page’s v2.1 notice with its v3.0 sidebar link and its warning about versions below 2.1. Tested the alternative active value against the v2.1 and v3.0 decision rows. Checked who made each statement in the 2021 thread and whether it established rescission of grants or a formal status decision.
challenge.results: The heading and prescribed notice both identify v2.1. The sidebar points to a separate v3.0 edition whose Index row carries active. The archived warning concerns versions below 2.1, whereas Rosen’s later statement reaches all pre-3.0 versions. These dated statements document a change in the scope of his position. Smith proposed retaining earlier forms as superseded for legacy uses. The exact v2.1 row independently resolves the editorial value as historical. The legal and board-record questions remain outside that finding.

limitations: Historical means the Index retains this distinct earlier form for reconciliation and documentary lookup after selection. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation, installation eligibility and release authorization require their own evidence.

Rosen recalled board approval, while Brasseur reported difficulty finding definitive proof. The correspondence records that evidentiary gap. It supplies neither an edition-specific board resolution nor a determination of the legal effect on existing grants.
Application to a particular work depends on its owner’s licensing notice and the applicable terms. The permission to copy the unmodified license text concerns the document itself.
reasoning: The archived OSI publication documents Academic Free License v2.1 and its software licensing terms. The Index admits historical editions and explicitly assigns historical to this v2.1 entity and HTML revision. The 2021 correspondence supports the narrower statement about Rosen’s treatment of earlier editions.
